summary: Made in USA Inc. filed Form 8-K announcing completion of an asset acquisition from affiliated seller Made in USA One LLC on June 26, 2026. Consideration was 5,000,000 restricted shares of common stock, with no cash paid. The acquired assets include domain names, AI tools, blockchain infrastructure, and operational platforms for a Made-in-USA verification business. The registrant acted as acquirer in this related-party deal. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor details were disclosed. Watch for shareholder dilution and resale restrictions under Rule 144.
